answer: The ripple schedule is applied in ocean and ember exposes each instalment. A payout is split thus 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An copycat thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4471 identities would post 2837 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
